audit.adaptation_reason: The source KL=21 conflicts with exact diagonal angles30 and70 and base45. Recomputed KL≈23.94 while retaining all angle conditions and the sought result.
audit.independent_solution: JK is parallel to ML. With JL as transversal, angle KJL equals angle MLJ=30 degrees.
